name: FREIA — France Real Estate Intelligence Agent
description: FREIA is a France-focused real-estate intelligence agent providing structured property and territory analysis from supported French public-data sources and supplied dated snapshots, with deterministic reporting. Separate commercial execution uses x402 v2 (scheme: exact; network: Base Mainnet / eip155:8453; asset: native USDC on Base). A client uses an existing commercial paymentId at https://freia.jlv-labs.cloud/commercial/execute/{paymentId}. The A2A endpoint remains Bearer-protected and does not claim an A2A-x402 extension. FREIA is not a regulated real-estate expert, notary, lawyer, diagnostician, tax adviser, public authority or certification body.

freiaBearer.description: Bearer credential required for A2A execution.

skills.name: FREIA Document
skills.description: Prudent analysis of supplied text or validated document envelopes. Raw PDF, image, audio and video are not supported.
examples: Analyse a supplied DPE or structured dossier envelope.

skills.name: FREIA Market
skills.description: Geo-DVF transaction diagnostics for available local datasets; when explicitly supplied, analyses authorised structured asking-price listings without portal scraping. Asking and transaction prices remain separate.
examples: Analyse Geo-DVF transactions for Roanne, Maison.
Compare supplied authorised structured listings; do not scrape portals.

skills.name: FREIA Cadastre
skills.description: Factual parcel and cadastral synthesis from supplied authorised dated official snapshots. It does not certify boundaries, ownership or constructibility.
examples: Analyse a supplied dated official parcel snapshot for a commune and parcel.

skills.name: FREIA Urbanism
skills.description: Factual PLU/PLUi zoning, prescriptions, servitudes and document-reference synthesis from supplied dated official snapshots. No live IGN/GPU retrieval and no permit or constructibility decision.
examples: Analyse supplied official PLU/PLUi snapshot references and zoning facts.

skills.name: FREIA Regulation
skills.description: Cautious synthesis of supplied dated official Légifrance or Service-Public snapshots. No live PISTE/Légifrance retrieval, legal opinion, certification or administrative decision.
examples: Summarise a supplied dated official regulatory source for an acquisition dossier.

skills.name: FREIA Decision
skills.description: Prudent multi-source acquisition/decision synthesis from normalized E1-E5 outputs only. It preserves contradictions and never merges asking prices with transaction prices.
examples: Create a cautious decision dossier from normalized document, market, cadastre, urbanism and regulation outputs.
